question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_lr, STDDEV("loss_rate_%") as std_lr
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
item_classes AS (
  SELECT 
    v.item_code,
    v.item_name,
    v."loss_rate_%",
    s.avg_lr,
    s.std_lr,
    s.avg_lr - s.std_lr as lower_bound,
    s.avg_lr + s.std_lr as upper_bound,
    CASE 
      WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_lr - s.std_lr THEN 'below'
      WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_lr + s.std_lr THEN 'above'
      ELSE 'within'
    END as category
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
)
SELECT 
  ROUND((SELECT avg_lr FROM stats), 4) as avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'below' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_below,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'within' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_within,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'above' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_above,
  COUNT(*) as total_items
FROM item_classes
